commit_message:
[Merged] [string] Extend caching for string-add-as-property-key

.. to also handle the `o[str + "constant"]` case, i.e. where the rhs is
a string constant.

Bug: 411350915
Change-Id: Ia70b9b35b955686b61a3618be9fe8159fa37fba1
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6578310
Reviewed-by: Igor Sheludko <ishell@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Jakob Linke <jgruber@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#100494}
pr_title: [string] Extend property-key string-add caching to RHS constants
pr_description:
Extend string-add caching for property keys to handle expressions such as o[str + "constant"]. Carry the constant-side variant through bytecode generation, interpreter and compiler paths, and runtime cache lookup while preserving operand order and conversion semantics.

The RHS-constant builtins accept the left operand as Object and the right operand as String. Mark the assertion-only constant operand as used for release builds.

agent_reasoning: The RHS-constant builtins previously copied the LHS-constant parameter declarations, incorrectly treating an arbitrary left operand as a String. Both the WithVector and Trampoline builtins now declare left as Object and right as String, matching the guaranteed constant side and avoiding the type confusion. The shared assembler also includes USE(const_str_operand), matching the supplied fix. Only two source files were edited, both match the fix commit exactly, no tests were modified, and workspace validation passed.
